Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Fixed damage-over-time startup estimates being replaced with inconsistent amounts before caster calibration is available. The shared correction applies across supported effects and preserves application snapshots, original diagnostic data, and previously saved encounters. Expanded regression coverage for live and saved totals, refreshes, and startup estimates.
